title: Reactivation Data of DoT (NSDL e-PASS)
purpose: Mobile numbers DoT has reconnected to the same person, as NSDL gives them each month on e-PASS (file type "Reactivation Data of DoT"). Only the hold Ledgerline placed because of the MNRL is lifted. NSDL does not publish the columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when e-PASS's differs). DoT's own reactivation list reads the same way.
linked: Clears the matching MNRL matches on Clients & onboarding → Revoked mobiles as Reactivated.
source: NSDL/POLICY/2026/0090 (16 Jun 2026), Annexure A: file type "Reactivation Data of DoT" on e-PASS, monthly from July 2026; remove only the suspension levied because of the MNRL. No column layout is published.
